docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The short Persian treatise of the Mughal prince Dārā Shikōh, who sought the common truth of Sufism and Vedānta, in English with Vasu’s introduction (Sacred Books of the Hindus, Allahabad, 1912). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Compass Of Truth · Shikoh Muhammad Dara · 1912, 47 scanned pages. Published 1912; Dārā Shikōh died 1659 and Srisa Chandra Vasu 1918; public domain in India.

The scans of this book are not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page was read from the scan by machine (OCR) for this library, and lightly cleaned; it may contain errors, and the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
